title: The carrier of an integer multiplicity triple lies Hⁿ-a.e. in the support of its weight measure
statement: Let P, n ∈ ℕ, U ⊆ ℝ^P (ℝ^P = Euclid P) and let R = (M, θ, ξ_R) be an integer multiplicity triple in U (R : IMRep U n), so M = R.carrier is a Borel set and θ = R.mult : ℝ^P → ℕ is measurable with θ(x) > 0 for every x ∈ M. Let Hⁿ := μHE[n] and let μ_R := R.measure = θ·(Hⁿ⌞M), i.e. the measure (Hⁿ.restrict M).withDensity (x ↦ θ(x)), with (closed) support spt μ_R = R.measure.support. Then Hⁿ(M ∖ spt μ_R) = 0.
lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (R : IMRep U n), μHE[n] (R.carrier \ R.measure.support) = 0
